rules: If something chases the cat then it is round.
If something is round then it sees the cat.
If something sees the cat then it is cold.
If something visits the cat and the cat sees the mouse then it chases the cat.
If the dog sees the mouse and the mouse chases the lion then the lion visits the dog.
If the dog sees the mouse then the mouse chases the cat.
If the mouse sees the dog then the mouse visits the cat.
